scraped.title: Young Persons' Secondary Vocational Education Programme
scraped.subtitle: Secondary Vocational Education Programme for Young Persons in Latin America
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union in Argentina
scraped.description: The program supports vulnerable youth aged 18 to 29 by improving their access to education and job opportunities. It strengthens national and provincial ministries, offers flexible secondary education options, and expands vocational training with updated curricula and resources.
body: The program supports vulnerable youth aged 18 to 29 by improving their access to education and job opportunities. It strengthens national and provincial ministries, offers flexible secondary education options, and expands vocational training with updated curricula and resources.

ICON-INSTITUT supported the initiative which directly benefits 190,000 young students and 23,000 vulnerable young adults, along with teachers and ministry staff. By enhancing education and job readiness, the program empowers young people for better futures and social integration.
